prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **All Star Karate**, at **235 Jungermann Road, Suite 101**. It teaches Isshinryu karate and offers kids’ classes focused on confidence, discipline, and self-defense; a local youth-sports guide also lists a free introductory program. [All Star Karate](https://allstarkarate.com/)

If you’re considering Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu instead, **Onyx Grappling** at **953 Jungermann Road** has age-grouped children’s classes and advertises a free introductory class. [Onyx Grappling](https://onyxgrappling.com/)

I’d try a class at whichever is more convenient and watch how the instructors handle beginners and keep kids engaged. Before signing up, ask about the full cost, contract and cancellation terms, class size, and whether parents can observe.
